spans.s:
mfn. (त्वः त्वा त्वं)
Other, different.
E.
तन to divide or spread, and व substituted for the final letter of the radical.

m. (-रः)
A sore or wound.
E.
त्वक् the skin, कण्डु itching or irritation, and र what excites.

f. (-रा)
The manna of the bambu.
E.
त्वच् the bark of the bambu, and क्षीर milk; also with ङीप् affix, त्वक्क्षीरी.

m. (-दः)
A plant, commonly Kshirakanchuki.
E.
त्वक् bark, and छद a leaf.

m. (-दः)
A cut, a scratch.
E.
त्वक्, and छेद a cut.

n. (-क्त्रं)
Armour.
E.
त्वक्, and त्र what preserves.

n. (-त्रं)
Woody cassia.
f. (-त्री)
A medicinal and vegetable substance: see हिङ्गुपत्री.
E.
त्वक् bark, and पत्र a leaf.

n. (-नं)
Desquamation, pealing of the skin.
E.
त्वक्, and परिपुटन pealing.

n. (-ष्पं)
Erection of the hairs of the body, horripilation.
nf. (-ष्पं-ष्पी)
Blotch, scab, cutaneous eruption, &c.
E.
म्बक् the skin, and पुष्प a flower.

f. (-का)
Scab, blotch: see the preceding.
E.
कन् added to त्वकपुष्पी.

m. (-रः)
1 A bambu.
2 Woody cassia.
f. (रा)
Bambu manna.
E.
त्वक् bark, and सार essence.

m. (-न्धः)
An orange.
f. (-न्धा)
A perfume, commonly Elavāluka.
E.
त्वक् skin or rind, and सुगन्ध fragrant.

m. (-दः)
A flesh wound, a scratch.
E.
त्वच्, and भेद breaking.

m. (-कः)
A stabber, a scratcher, one who draws blood from the skin.
E.
त्वच्, and भेदक who cuts.

(ऊ) त्वक्षू r. 1st cl. (त्वक्षति)
1 To pare, to make thin.
2 To be thin.
3 To peel, to skin.

(इ) त्वगि r. 1st cl. (त्वंगति)
To go, to move.

m. (-रः)
Erection of the hairs of the body.
E.
त्वच् or त्वक् skin, and अङ्कुर a sprout.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
Reduced to a skeleton, to mere skin and bone.
E.
त्वच् skin, अस्थि bone, मात्र mere, and शेष end.

f. (-री)
The manna of the bambu.
E.
त्वक् bark, आङ् limitative, and क्षीरी milk, being of a milky colour.

m. (-न्धः)
An orange.
E.
त्वच् rind, गन्ध smell.

m. (-षः)
Leprosy.
E.
त्वक्, and दोष fault.

Leprosy.
2

Any cutaneous disease.
E.
त्वच्, and रोग disease.

n. (-रं)
The expression, ‘thou.’
E.
त्व, and कार making.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Made of bark or skin.
E.
त्वक् skin, and मयट् aff.

r. 6th cl. (त्वचति)
To cover, to clothe, to invest.

Skin.
2

Bark, rind.
3 Woody cassia: see the preceding.

mfn. (-चः-ची-चं)
1 Cuticular, relating to the skin.
2 Contagious, derived from touch.
E.
त्वच्, and अण् aff.

f. (त्वक्)
1

Skin.
2

Bark, rind, peel, &c.
3 Woody cassia.
E.
तन to spread, to encircle or cover, Uṇādi affix चिक्, and व substituted for the final letters of the radical; also अच being added त्वच and त्वचा.

n. (-त्रं)
Woody cassia.
E.
त्वचा bark, and पत्र a leaf; also त्वक्पत्र.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Having abundant skin or bark.
E.
त्वच skin, इष्ठन् affix of the superlative; also with ईयसुन् affix त्वचीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः).

m. (-रः)
A bambu.
E.
त्वचि seventh case of त्वच्, in the bark, and सार strength, pith; also त्वक्सार.

f. (-न्धा)
Small cardamoms.
E.
त्वचि in the bark, सुगन्ध fragrance.

(उ) तञ्जु r. 1st cl. (त्वञ्चति)
To go, or move.

mfn. (-त्वत्)
Other, different: see त्व.

mfn. (-त्कः-त्का-त्कं)
Thine, your.
E.
त्वत् thine, and कन् added.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Thine.
E.
त्वत्, from त्वं thou, and छ added.

(ञि आ) ञित्वरा r. 1st cl. (त्वरते)
To hurry, to make haste, to go or move with speed, to do any thing readily or precipitately.

f. (-रा)
Haste, speed.
E.
त्वर to make haste, affixes अङ् and टाप्.

n. (-णं)
Making haste, speed, velocity.
E.
त्वर to haste, and ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Hastening, making haste, going speedily.
E.
त्वर to be quick, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Swift, quick.
E.
त्वरा haste, and अन्वित possessed of.

mfn. subst. (-णः-णा-णं)
Adherence, attachment.
E.
त्वर to go, with speed, and युच् affix: see तुरायण.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Quick, expeditious.
E.
त्वरा, and युक्त having.

f. (-रिः)
Haste, speed.
E.
त्वर to make haste, affix इन्.

mfn. subst. (-तः-ता-तं)
Quick, swift, expeditious.
n. (-तं)
Dispatch, haste.
adv.
Quickly, swiftly.
E.
त्वर to make haste, affix क्त, and इट् inserted.

f. (-तिः)
1 Swift motion.
2 A species of the Paṅkti metre.
E.
त्वरित, गति going.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Spoken fast, hurried.
E.
त्वरित quickly, उदित said.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Pared, made thin.
E.
त्वक्ष to make thin, affix क्त.

f. (-ष्टिः)
Carpentry.
E.
त्वक्ष to plane, क्तिन् aff.

m. (-ष्टा)
1 A carpenter.
2 A name of VIŚVAKARMĀ, the artist of the gods.
E.
त्वक्ष to pare, affix तृच्.
3 The sun.
E.
तिष to shine, Uṇādi affix तृच्, and अ substituted for the radical इ.

n. (-क्षं)
Ascertainment of objects by contact.
E.
त्वाच, and प्रत्यक्ष perception.

m. (-ष्ट्रः)
The name of a demon, also called VṚTRĀSURA.
nf. (-ष्ट्रं-ष्ट्री)
One of the lunar mansions, the fourteenth or Citra.
f. (-ष्ट्री)
1 A wife of SŪRYA, or the sun; also called SAṂJÑĀ, the daughter of

VIŚVAKARMA.
2

A small car.
E.
त्वष्टृ the sun, or a carpenter, अण् affix of relation or descent, and ङीप् fem. aff.
